  "rationale": "The 30-day retention rule must remain. Users reportedly recreate drafts because “Delete draft” implies their work is gone. The proposal gives the action a clear label, explains retention after hiding, and places “Restore draft” beside the message. Its verification plan checks recovery of the same draft after returning, keyboard access, and screen-reader feedback. The fixture leaves the existing recovery path unresolved. The events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match."
